### 1. The "Free but Capped" Reality
AI companies place limits on how many messages you can send within a certain timeframe.

If you ever hit the browser's message limit and don't want to wait 5 hours for it to reset, you have an industry-level, 100% free alternative: **Run Qwen locally on your own machine.**

Game studios literally hire "graphics programmers" and "technical artists" who never open Blender — they write code that *generates* what artists would sculpt by hand.
